We are sorry to hear you have been struggling to get an appointment. To book GP appointment, you can either ring us or book at the front desk at 8.00am on a weekday. You will be placed into a queue but we will answer your call. We apologise for any long waiting times you may have experienced. A closed message is added onto the phones once the number of triage appointments available reaches the amount of patients in the phone queue and at the front desk. We do also have an urgent list once triage is closed for any medically urgent requests. Alternatively to save waiting in our phone queue, you can fill out an online form. We have recently had to transfer to a new software called Paco Blinx but this worked the same as patchs where it is open 8.00am till 6.30pm every weekday so you can request a GP appointment anytime during this and can also request on here to see a specific GP of you prefer. This does not fill up so not sure why you received this message. It did in the past many months ago but it no longer does due to the new gp contract. Unfortunately on this particular day you phoned, we had only just transferred to this new system and was having some teething problems as can be expected but many patients were able to use this system and were able to obtain an appointment. It is a quick and great way to obtain an appointment whilst avoiding the phone/desk queues and we have had alot of good feedback around this. 
When a patient has concerns they wish to speak with the practice manager, a complaint form must ideally be filled to obtain as much information as possible in order to investigate and help resolve any concerns the best we can. This does not mean the complaint is formal at this stage unless the patient wishes to make it formal. 
We hope you have managed to obtain an appointment and we apologise for any inconvenience you may have experienced. We hope this explanation has helped in some way.
